newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Fibre names Peter Darbee CFO.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Fibre names Peter Darbee CFO.

text.p: Advanced Fibre Communications Inc said Monday that Peter Darbee was named vice president and chief financial officer effective June 30.
Darbee is currently vice president, merger planning at Pacific Bell PAC.N and has for the past three years served as chief financial officer and controller.
Effective June 30, the company said, Carl Grivner, currently its president and chief operating officer, will assume the additional title of chief executive.

Don Green, current chairman of the board and CEO, will remain as chairman and continue to have an active role in the future of the company, primarily in the area of strategic direction, Advanced Fibre said.
Dan Steimle, currently vice president and chief financial officer, will assume the new title of vice president, business development, the company said.
